creditUsageBlock.title: Credit Usage
creditUsageBlock.description: A responsive credit-cycle card with model attribution, projected depletion, automatic fallback, and plan actions.
creditUsageBlock.compositionBody: The block composes Card, Badge, pill Tabs, Switch, Button, InlineNotice, and the shared icon context. Its segmented usage bar is a small block-owned visualization driven by semantic model colors.
creditUsageBlock.dataContractBody: Pass the plan allowance plus current and optional previous cycle models. Use provider for the built-in OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini marks, or logo for a private model's real brand asset. The block normalizes invalid credits, derives totals and percentages, and exposes full-sentence formatters for localization, while the host owns billing data, dates, routes, mutations, and pending or error state.
creditUsageBlock.behaviorBody: Cycle selection and automatic switching support controlled and uncontrolled use. Set-limit and upgrade controls appear only when their callbacks exist, so every visible action remains functional.
